inbox.title: Approvals
inbox.subtitlePending_one: {{count}} action is waiting for your decision
inbox.subtitlePending_other: {{count}} actions are waiting for your decision
inbox.emptyDescription: Agents ask here before risky actions: dangerous commands, network access, secrets and deployments.

toast.vaultLockedBody: Access to secrets is denied until you unlock the vault.

emergency.buttonEngagedTitle: All AI is stopped (click to lift the stop)
emergency.title: Stop all AI?
emergency.descriptionEngaged: Agents and the Manager stay blocked until you lift the stop.
emergency.description: Immediately stops every agent and the Manager and cancels their pending approvals. Works offline.
emergency.descriptionProject: Immediately stops this project's agents, Manager runs and checks and cancels their pending approvals. Other projects keep working. Works offline.
emergency.stopProjectTitle: Stop the AI work of project “{{name}}” only; other projects keep working

descriptions.Ask: Every write, command and git action asks first.
descriptions.SemiAuto: Routine work inside the worktree runs on its own; risky actions ask.
descriptions.FullAuto: Everything the policy allows runs. Dangerous actions still ask.

permissions.openProject: Open a project to set its approval mode.
permissions.effectiveMode: The effective mode is {{mode}}: Full Auto is disabled by an emergency control.
permissions.disableFullAutoHint: No project can run above Semi-Auto.
permissions.disableNetworkHint: Agents lose network and browser access.
permissions.rulesHint: The narrowest scope wins (task › agent › project › global); at equal scope Deny beats Ask, and Ask beats Allow.
permissions.resourceHint: Glob pattern. Leave empty for any resource.
permissions.noRulesDescription: Approval-mode defaults apply. Dangerous actions always ask; forbidden ones are always denied.
permissions.checkAria: Test a command against the policy

secrets.title: Secrets Vault
secrets.name: Name
secrets.valueHint: Stored in the OS keyring or the encrypted vault. The value is never shown again.
secrets.emptyDescription: Provider API keys and environment credentials live here. Agents never see the values unless a task explicitly binds them.
secrets.confirmDelete: Delete the secret “{{name}}”? Anything that uses it will stop working.

validation.nameInvalid: Use Latin letters, digits and _ . -, and start with a letter or _.

privacy.noProject: Open a project to set its AI privacy.
privacy.intro: Choose which AI providers may see the code of “{{name}}”. Orkestr applies this to agents, the Manager, reviews, merges and summaries.

aiModeHint.CloudAllowed: Any configured cloud or local provider may receive the project’s code.
aiModeHint.SelectedProvidersOnly: Only the providers you select below may receive the project’s code.
aiModeHint.LocalModelsOnly: Only models running on this computer (for example Ollama). Nothing leaves the machine.

privacy.providersNone: No provider is selected yet, so no model can work on this project.

classificationHint.Public: Open-source or public code. The provider policy above applies as set.
classificationHint.Internal: Internal company code. The provider policy above applies as set.
classificationHint.Confidential: Confidential data: general cloud access is not allowed. Use selected providers or local models; sync only to a self-hosted server.
classificationHint.Secret: Secret data: local models only and no remote sync, whatever the provider policy says.

privacy.effective: Because the project is classified as “{{classification}}”, Orkestr uses “{{mode}}”.
